commits: 096ffe3 fix(F-039): frame phone wing stops from the measured wing head
approach: Preferred R4 approach. On portrait, CameraRig measures the wing head (the parent of the exit control: chip plus 'Return to the aisle', ResizeObserver and resize, fallback 140 px) and framing.ts wingPortraitY puts the wall title's top WING_HEAD_CLEARANCE (8 px) under its bottom. The title top is the number's cap line across the widest line, from slotPlacard (the placard the wall draws), as a tangent from the stop pose (topTangent), so the shift is exact for any FOV. The point never rises above the 36% portrait point and never drops below 50%. It blends over the half stop next to each wing exhibit (stopWeightAt), so the wing door stops (F-038) and every main stop keep their framing; desktop is untouched (aspect >= 1).

acceptance.evidence: The check now reads the live framing: the title boxes are projected with the plain framing and moved by the offset between screenPos(id) (the real projection of the hit-box center) and the same center projected that way, so it does not repeat the fix. With the fix: all three pass.

JOHN'S whole, case and round table whole above the card. 360 x 640: klarup (P1 KLARUP) and finance-tracker whole with the case above the card; sdsj reads V1 and both organization lines whole, but its tall card (top y 327) now covers the case floor and the round table's pedestal (see deviations). The captures were taken locally and are not committed (review/runs is outside this brief's globs).

New 'wing framing (F-039)' tests: topTangent matches three.js projection; stopWeightAt; wingPortraitY bounds (never above 0.36, at most 0.5); framingFor applies it on portrait only and blends by weight; at 412 x 839 and 360 x 640 every wing title's top projects at least 148 px (head bottom 140 + 8) through a framed three.js camera.

Specs: 69 passed, 0 failed in 15.1 min (project-gated tests skipped), including camera (f) desk at pixel7 and 360 x 640 (F-020), rail-input (g) door transom titles on desktop and pixel7 (F-038) and the new wing-stop checks.

stop-klarup-pixel7, stop-finance-tracker-pixel7 and stop-sdsj-pixel7 change (the wing framing drops on phones); R0 regenerates them in CI. Desktop wing baselines and the door baselines should not change.

deviations: At 360 x 640 sdsj the band between the wing head (bottom 140) and the tall V1 card (top 327) is shorter than the title-to-case-floor span (about 207 px at FOV 68), so the title wins as the brief requires: the title sits 8 px under the head and the card covers the case floor and the round table's pedestal (the table top still shows). Klarup and finance-tracker at 360 x 640 and all three on Pixel 7 keep the whole case above the card. A further fix needs a shorter phone wing card or the compact wing head (R6 alternative); not done here.

rail-input (g) at the wing stops no longer assumes the framing: it reads the live shift through screenPos. The F-038 door check still projects with the plain framing, which the wing framing leaves unchanged at the doors.
CameraRig imports slotPlacard from src/museum/exhibits/_kit/placard.ts (read only) so the framing uses the title the wall actually draws.
